inputs.command:
set -u; printf '%s
' DB_DISCOVERY_START; date -u +%FT%TZ; hostname; id -u; printf '%s
' --DEPLOYED--; cat /opt/madworld/.github-deployed-sha 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' --CONTAINERS--; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | sort; printf '%s
' --POSTGRES_ENV--; docker inspect madworld-postgres-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/(PASSWORD=).*/\1<redacted>/; s/(SECRET=).*/\1<redacted>/' | sort || true; printf '%s
' --COMPOSE_POSTGRES--; grep -RniE 'POSTGRES_(DB|USER)|DATABASE_URL|DB_NAME|DB_DATABASE' ops .env* 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/(PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN|KEY)=.*/\1=<redacted>/' | head -100 || true; printf '%s
' --DB_LIST--; for db in postgres madworld madworld_prod madworld_production; do docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U madworld -d postgres -Atc "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${db}';" 2>/dev/null || true; done; printf '%s
' DB_DISCOVERY_DONE
